## Summary

I implemented F002 by extending `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/reconcile.py` with a read-only `check` subcommand and a pure comparison core: `diff_capability_fingerprints` (new/removed/changed by capability_id with old/current fingerprints), `evaluate_status_cache` (fresh/missing/stale/unknown against the snapshot's `generated_at`), and `check_capabilities` orchestrating both — all anchored on the F001 install snapshot at `~/.dontpanic/install-snapshot.json` (never on doctor output). Text and JSON renderers both surface the exact next commands (`dontpanic reconcile baseline --yes` for missing snapshot or capability drift, `dontpanic capabilities status` for stale/missing cache); the JSON envelope is pinned to `CHECK_SCHEMA_VERSION="1.0.0"` with stable top-level keys. The CLI was already routed through `cli.py`'s top-level dispatcher; I added the `check` subparser along
